node.title: XR minor-specialization certificate semantics
node.statement: In the light-triangle eliminant normal form, a certificate consisting of a maximal minor and one admissible specialization at which that minor evaluates nonzero proves that the corresponding minor polynomial is nonzero on the profile chart.
node.attack_surface: formal determinant-polynomial semantics over the profile chart coordinate ring
node.falsifier: a polynomial minor that evaluates nonzero at an admissible specialization while being identically zero
